facts.fact: 夜间爆炸只毁掉 WCLC 所在的五楼，楼上楼下都完好。
facts.anchor: Only the fifth, entirely occupied by the WCLC, the Welcome Centre for Lost Children, has been destroyed.

facts.fact: 同一夜五处 WCLC 中心被炸，数十人死伤。
facts.anchor: Five explosions, five centres of the WCLC destroyed, dozens of victims.

facts.fact: Tinker Bell 说 Peter 是神，几条人命在他眼里无足轻重。
facts.anchor: Peter is a god, girls. He puts the death of a handful of human beings very much in perspective.

facts.fact: Wendy 拒绝 Tinker Bell 的撤离提议，宣布留下。
facts.anchor: “We’re staying,” announces Wendy in a tone that leaves no room for reply.

facts.fact: 祖父自曝真名是 Silenus，即 Dionysus 的老师。
Greta 拨通 WCLC 的电话，把 Michele 一伙告发出去。
facts.anchor: Greta can already see her picture in the papers, when she keys in the number for the WCLC.

facts.fact: Hook 用钩子砸碎仙女锻造的剑。
facts.anchor: The enchanted sword, forged by the fairies when Time was newborn, shatters into pieces.

facts.fact: Dagon 报信：Hook 抓走了 Michele，需要他的血脱身。
facts.anchor: “Greyface took him,” he manages to say.
